name: Tarkov Dual Sense Adaptive Triggers
teaser: Want to play with realistic triggers on a controller? This allows people with ps5 dual sense controllers to have triggers that feel like real triggers and even react to weapon malfunctions.  This uses an external program to provide controller input.
description_html:
Customizable settings in the dvize.DSX folder by editing the config json file. I’m not going to take the time to explain how to customize it but you can look at the instructions document and compare to the actual config file to get an idea.

Use DSX Adaptive Triggers with Tarkov. THIS IS ONLY FOR OFFLINE SINGLE PLAYER TARKOV.
PLEASE ASK AROUND IN DISCORD SERVER IF YOU DO NOT KNOW HOW TO INSTALL SINGLE PLAYER TARKOV (SPT)

Requirements

  1. DSX Free or Steam Version (Steam version fullly works properly) … free version half works because the formatting changed. DSX Version 2.X only works for now.
  2. Amand’s Controller Mod.

AmandsController

DSX free version in release section - You can grab the latest release from DEC 2021.

The free version doesn’t have working lights or the vibrating triggers - i guess the format has changed so i’m not going to bother making it fully work with the free version.

The port for UDP must be set to 6969 for DSX (which is default)

Installation unzip directly into your bepinex folder and it should put a dvize.DSX folder inside your bepinex/plugins folder if it was installed correctly.
